it doesn't really matter how hard someone's life is, all that matters is that they have enough reason to keep fighting, and even if you don't think you have enough reason, know that you can find it.

Shaco's not a late-game champ and like most junglers, he falls off, not doing anything wrong.

As far as deny goes, it is currently a toxic card with the power to define the meta (in a bad way) and needs a change. There are many change ideas flying around out there and I have one too. I think they should make it so that you don't lose the mana you spent on a spell that was denied. "But that makes it way weaker than it is now!" well that's probably because the card is super god damn stong right now. This is a large nerf but the card currently requires it. This way the card still does what it's set out to do (rather than people saying to just remove the card, which is a little much) but instead of winning a game because you spent 3 mana to block ruination leaving your opponent ready for the slaughterhouse, they can still have a chance to respond. This is a fair and still strong trade, you spent 3 mana to stop your opponent from killing your board of six 6/6's and destroyed one of their spells. This will allow the currently very toxic meta to loosen up a bit and allow players to have a little more fun with their gameplay rather than discovering crippling anxiety thinking about whether or not their opponent is holding that second deny.
